spans.text: Ajjeva kiccamātappaṁ, Atha kho candano devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṁ nigrodhārāmaṁ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṁ aṭṭhāsi.

entries.object: caramāno yena sāvatthi jetavanaṁ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami

spans.text: Taṁ ve bhaddekarattoti, Anupubbena cārikaṁ caramāno yena sāvatthi jetavanaṁ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi.
“Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
“Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
‘Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
Evaṁ vutte, ahaṁ, bhante, taṁ devaputtaṁ etadavocaṁ: ‘na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
“Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
“Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
‘Na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
Evaṁ vutte, ahaṁ, bhante, taṁ devaputtaṁ etadavocaṁ: ‘na kho ahaṁ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
“Na kho ahaṁ, bhante, jānāmi taṁ devaputtan”ti.
“That godling was named Candana.
Candana pays attention, applies the mind, concentrates wholeheartedly, and actively listens to the teaching.
